mapper.sql: id, author_id, parent_id, name, path, level, sort_order, create_time, update_time
f.id, f.author_id, f.parent_id, f.name, f.path, f.level, f.sort_order, f.create_time, f.update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO folder ( author_id, parent_id, name, path, level ) VALUES ( #{authorId}, #{parentId}, #{name}, #{path}, #{level} )
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(f.level) FROM folder f INNER JOIN folder root ON root.id = #{folderId} WHERE f.author_id = root.author_id AND ( f.path = root.path OR f.path LIKE CONCAT(root.path, '/%') )
